_comment: V3.6-A POI 視覺探針（選擇器以寫手清單為準：.mk-poi-wrap 104x30 / .mk-poi / .poi-ic / .poi-nm / button.poi-enter / #eventModal）

checks.name: poi_count
checks.expr: JSON.stringify({wrap: document.querySelectorAll('.mk-poi-wrap').length, mkPoi: document.querySelectorAll('.mk-poi').length, ic: document.querySelectorAll('.poi-ic').length, nm: document.querySelectorAll('.poi-nm').length, enter: document.querySelectorAll('.poi-enter').length, defs: Sim.poiList().length})

checks.name: poi_content
checks.expr: JSON.stringify(Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.mk-poi')).map(function(e){var w=e.closest('.mk-poi-wrap'); var wr=w?w.getBoundingClientRect():null; return {ic:e.querySelector('.poi-ic').textContent.trim(), nm:e.querySelector('.poi-nm').textContent.trim(), btn:e.querySelector('.poi-enter').textContent.trim(), wrapW: wr?Math.round(wr.width):null, wrapH: wr?Math.round(wr.height):null};}))

checks.name: poi_overlap
checks.expr: JSON.stringify((function(){function box(el){var r=el.getBoundingClientRect(); return {x:r.left,y:r.top,w:r.width,h:r.height};} function zOf(el){var m=el.closest('.leaflet-marker-icon'); return m?getComputedStyle(m).zIndex:'none';} var out={overlaps:[],topSample:null}; var pois=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.mk-poi')); var others=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.mk-hq')).concat(Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.mk-mis'))).concat(Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.cop-icon'))); pois.forEach(function(p){var a=box(p); var az=zOf(p); others.forEach(function(o){var b=box(o); var ix=Math.min(a.x+a.w,b.x+b.w)-Math.max(a.x,b.x); var iy=Math.min(a.y+a.h,b.y+b.h)-Math.max(a.y,b.y); if(ix>0&&iy>0){out.overlaps.push({poiZ:az, otherSel:o.className||o.id, otherZ:zOf(o), px:Math.round(ix*iy)});}});}); var h=out.overlaps[0]; if(h){} return out;})())

checks.name: near_button
checks.expr: JSON.stringify((function(){var p=Sim.poiList()[0]; var s=Sim.state(); s.hero.pos={lat:p.lat+0.0002, lng:p.lng}; GameMap.updatePoiButtons(); var near=Sim.poiNearHero(); var res={target:p.id, nearId:near?near.id:null, buttons:[]}; document.querySelectorAll('.mk-poi').forEach(function(e){var b=e.querySelector('.poi-enter'); var r=b.getBoundingClientRect(); var mr=e.getBoundingClientRect(); var map=document.getElementById('map').getBoundingClientRect(); res.buttons.push({nm:e.querySelector('.poi-nm').textContent.trim(), noHidden:!b.classList.contains('hidden'), visible:b.offsetParent!==null, w:Math.round(r.width), h:Math.round(r.height), inVp:r.left>=0&&r.top>=0&&r.right<=map.right&&r.bottom<=map.bottom, overName:(function(){var n=e.querySelector('.poi-nm'); if(!n||b.classList.contains('hidden'))return false; var nr=n.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.left<nr.right&&r.right>nr.left&&r.top<nr.bottom&&r.bottom>nr.top;})(), btnRelMarker:{dx:Math.round(r.left-mr.left), dy:Math.round(r.top-mr.top)}});}); return res;})())

checks.name: far_button
checks.expr: JSON.stringify((function(){var s=Sim.state(); s.hero.pos={lat:25.5, lng:121.5}; GameMap.updatePoiButtons(); var bs=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.poi-enter')); return {total:bs.length, allHidden:bs.every(function(b){return b.classList.contains('hidden');}), domKept:bs.length===8, anyVisible:bs.some(function(b){return b.offsetParent!==null;})};})())

checks.name: event_open
checks.expr: JSON.stringify((function(){var p=Sim.poiList()[0]; var s=Sim.state(); s.hero.pos={lat:p.lat+0.0002, lng:p.lng}; GameMap.updatePoiButtons(); var btn=document.querySelector('.mk-poi .poi-enter'); if(!btn) return {err:'no-btn'}; btn.click(); return {clicked:true};})())

checks.name: event_card_content
checks.expr: JSON.stringify((function(){var m=document.getElementById('eventModal'); if(m.classList.contains('hidden')) return {open:false}; var g=function(id){var e=document.getElementById(id); return e?e.textContent.trim():null;}; function ov(e){return e&&e.scrollWidth>e.clientWidth+1;} var ea=document.getElementById('evA'), eb=document.getElementById('evB'); var mr=m.getBoundingClientRect(); return {open:true, evIcon:g('evIcon'), evTitle:g('evTitle'), evTextLen:(g('evText')||'').length, evTextOv:ov(document.getElementById('evText')), evA:g('evA'), evAOv:ov(ea), evB:g('evB'), evBOv:ov(eb), cardW:Math.round(mr.width), cardH:Math.round(mr.height), inVp:mr.left>=0&&mr.top>=0&&mr.right<=window.innerWidth&&mr.bottom<=window.innerHeight, hasMask:getComputedStyle(m).position};})())

checks.name: event_close
checks.expr: JSON.stringify((function(){var a=document.getElementById('evA'); if(!a) return {err:'no-evA'}; a.click(); var m=document.getElementById('eventModal'); return {closed:m.classList.contains('hidden')};})())
